bojo.description: Jarvis is a voice-activated, conversational AI assistant powered by a local LLM (Qwen via Ollama). It listens for a wake word, processes spoken commands using a local language model with LangChain, and responds out loud via TTS. It supports tool-calling for dynamic functions like checking the current time.
A local AI agent built from scratch in Python with Ollama: conversation memory, system prompts, and multi-step tool calling.

Vui Nano — a small, context-aware text-to-speech model trained on real conversations. 219M active params (305M total), Apache 2.0, voice cloning, streaming, runs on CPU (dependency-free C build). Ships with a full real-time voice assistant: WebRTC, ASR, local LLM, OpenAI Realtime API compatible.

TypeScript AI SDK and agent framework with zero dependencies. Build production AI agents and multi-agent swarms: durable execution, long-term memory, hybrid RAG, MCP client/server, A2A, human-in-the-loop approvals, CodeAct sandboxes, realtime voice. One streaming API, 29 providers: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama. Node, Bun, Deno, edge.

LangChain4j is an idiomatic, open-source Java library for building LLM-powered applications on the JVM. It offers a unified API over popular LLM providers and vector stores, and makes implementing tool calling (including MCP support), agents and RAG easy. It integrates seamlessly with enterprise Java frameworks like Quarkus and Spring Boot.

Java 8+ agentic SDK: unified LLM access (OpenAI/Anthropic/DashScope/Doubao/DeepSeek...),unified AI service(image/video/audio...), Tool Calling, MCP, RAG, SKILLS,Agent Runtime, A2A, agent blueprint, agent harness, and a built-in Coding Agent CLI/TUI/ACP.

Self-hosted AI studio on your own GPU: chat with your files (RAG), screen and browser agents, coding swarms, LoRA training, an MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor, and local video, image, music and voice generation. No telemetry.
Alice is a voice-first desktop AI assistant application built with Vue.js, Vite, and Electron. Advanced memory system, function calling, MCP support, optional fully local use, and more.
Local, OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech (TTS) API using Chatterbox, enabling users to generate voice cloned speech anywhere the OpenAI API is used (e.g. Open WebUI, AnythingLLM, etc.)
Self-hostable multimodal chat with local LLMs (Ollama/OpenAI): PDF RAG, image chat, and Whisper voice, Streamlit + Docker.
Self-hosted personal AI agent with a WebUI, memory, tools, MCP, sub-agents and automations. Connect local or cloud LLMs.
Local-first Telegram AI bot with Ollama tool calling, voice transcription, MinIO storage, SearchApi web search, and readiness checks
Local-first AI PKM for coding conversations: import Claude Code/Cursor/Codex, distill notes, semantic search, tag graph, MCP memory.

Local-first memory layer for LLM apps and agents. Runs offline on Ollama, sentence-transformers and FAISS; OpenAI and Anthropic optional. Importance scoring, contradiction resolution, confidence-aware retrieval.

From messy files to a checked report. A free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux: write and analyse with AI from your own files, check each sentence and figure against them, and export to Word. Meeting notes too. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or a local model through Ollama.

Free, high-quality text-to-speech API endpoint to replace OpenAI, Azure, or ElevenLabs
Automation foundation model for tiny devices: 2-bit, 8-29 MB, tool calls, ASR, structured extraction and embeddings on phones, wearables, smart homes, robots, cars and microcontrollers.

Unreal Engine plugin for LLM/GenAI models & MCP UE5 server. OpenAI GPT-5, Deepseek R1, Claude Opus/Sonnet, Gemini 3, Grok 4, Alibaba Qwen, Kimi, ElevenLabs TTS, Inworld, OpenRouter, Groq, GLM, Ollama, Local, Meshy, Tripo, Hunyuan3D, Rodin, fal, Dashscope, Seedream. NPC AI, agentic, chat, 3D gen, TTS, multimodal, image gen. UnrealMCP/UnrealClaude
The open source coding agent for your terminal.
Home Assistant LLM integration for local OpenAI-compatible services (llamacpp, vllm, etc)

~95% on SimpleQA (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B on a 3090). Supports all local and cloud LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, Google, ...). 10+ search engines - arXiv, PubMed, your private documents. Everything Local & Encrypted.
MeetDo — open-source Meeting-to-Action AI by 筑听 · JKinco Listen. Self-hosted live meetings, local ASR/LLM, structured minutes, DOCX/PDF.
Open source voice AI platform. Self-hosted alternative to Vapi and Retell. On Prem, BYOK across  Speech to Speech or LLM/STT/TTS, with a visual workflow builder, MCP native and telephony support.

M.I.L.E.S, a GPT-4-Turbo voice assistant, self-adapts its prompts and AI model, can play any Spotify song, adjusts system and Spotify volume, performs calculations, browses the web and internet, searches global weather, delivers date and time, autonomously chooses and retains long-term memories. Available for macOS and Windows.
Cognithor · Agent OS: Local-first autonomous agent operating system. 19 LLM providers, 18 channels, 145 MCP tools, 6-tier memory, Agent Packs marketplace, zero telemetry. Python 3.12+, Apache 2.0.

Local AI desktop app: a Chromium browser with a GPU-aware llama.cpp runtime, OpenAI-compatible API, AI chat and agents, Stable Diffusion image/video, TTS and music, plus an MCP server so Claude Code, Codex and Cline can drive your browser. Windows, macOS, Linux.

Local code search combining BM25, vector similarity, and cross-encoder reranking. Parses 60+ languages with tree-sitter, runs entirely offline, and returns structured results with file paths, line ranges, and symbol metadata. Built in Rust.
VT.ai - multimodal AI chat app with dynamic conversation routing

The Swiss Army Knife of Offline AI. Chat, see, speak, and generate images on your phone or Mac — GGUF LLMs, vision, Whisper speech-to-text, Stable Diffusion, tool calling, and local-network servers. Runs on your CPU, GPU, or NPU. No account, no API key, zero data leaves your device.
Curated list of self-hosted open-source AI: local LLMs, chat UIs, agents, MCP servers, RAG, speech and image generation. Health-checked weekly, dead projects removed automatically.
Professional AI research tool for Zotero: chat with PDFs, whole-library search, Literature Radar, AutoPilot. 30+ LLMs or local models; built-in MCP server.
Self-hosted AI workspace where chat becomes visual workflows, multi-agent operations, and reviewable automations. Local memory; local or cloud models
Smart multi-agent conversational assistant with LangGraph orchestration, Human-in-the-Loop, enterprise-grade observability, and full i18n support (6 languages)
Local OpenCode-backed LLM gateway for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Responses API-compatible tools, with streaming and tool/function calling.
Own your AI memory — import ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini exports, see what each AI knows about you. Checkpoint/restore and cross-model continuity for agents.
A harness optimized to smaller LLMs

An embeddable cross-platform AI agent library written in C. Cloud and local LLMs, tool calling, long-term memory, voice, sessions, research mode, self-evolving loops. The SQLite of agent frameworks: small, portable, just works.

Self-hosted voice for coding agents. Talk from any browser or a Telegram call, interrupt mid-sentence, clone any voice, and hand real work to agents that ship PRs. Local STT/TTS; real-time voice client for ACP.

A memory-first AI agent that remembers why decisions were made — not just the last message. Runs local (Ollama), cloud (Claude · OpenAI · Gemini), or decentralized TEE. Graph memory, self-learning skills, multi-model routing, sandboxed tools. MCP · ACP · A2A. One Rust binary.

tys.description: Self-hosted control plane for AI agents: dispatch tasks, review runs, track spend, and operate OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, and other runtimes.

For EHRs, payer portals, and any app your team clicks through. A person or an agent shows the task; OpenAdapt turns it into a local program that repeats the steps with no model calls, checks each save, and stops when something doesn't match.

Browser automation CLI built for AI agents. Break through anti-bot walls, hand off to humans across platforms when stuck. Parallel multi-task execution, independent multi-session operation, isolated multi-account browsing.

Personal AI agent harness for macOS, Windows, Linux, Android & iOS. New: Skales Scout, lasting AI agents that keep working on your desk, each optionally in its own virtual machine. Chat, coding (Skales Code), Flow, automations, computer use, browser, voice, MCP, local LLMs (Ollama). BYOK, 26 providers. No Docker, no terminal.
2,884+ reusable AI agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. AAS Core adds local catalog discovery, agent-owned selection and plan preview. CLI, MCP and plugins.
Open-source benchmark for browser AI agents on daily tasks.
Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS sandboxes, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.

See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.

本地优先的跨平台 Claude Code / AI Agent 桌面工作台：多 Agent 协作、Git Worktree、代码 Diff、技能市场、多模型、Computer Use、桌面宠物；支持微信、飞书、钉钉及 H5 等远程访问。 | Local-first Claude Code / AI Agent desktop workspace: multi-agent teams, Git worktrees, diffs, skills marketplace, multi-model, Computer Use, task-aware desktop pets; remote via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, WhatsApp & H5.

ARTEMIS turns natural-language instructions into reliable Android automation. It automates end-to-end workflows, captures logs, and integrates seamlessly with AI coding assistants such as Antigravity, Codex, and Claude Code.  It also achieves 99%+ success rate on AndroidWorld Benchmark.
Free, local tool to track AI coding token usage and cost across 37 tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and more), by model, project, and task. npx codeburn

The browser control plane for AI agents. One API over Oya Cloud, Browserbase, Steel, Anchor, Browser Use and your own Chrome, with persistent personas, CAPTCHA and MFA handling, and live human takeover.

Spec-driven, agentic workflow framework for AI coding agents. Turn a request into a verifiable goal loop — plan, act, verify — with durable specs and evidence in your repo. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, and plain CLI.
🔥 Open Source Browser API for AI Agents & Apps. Steel Browser is a batteries-included browser sandbox that lets you automate the web without worrying about infrastructure.
✨ All your agents and workspaces in one place, on every device you own. Track tasks on a board, accessible from desktop, mobile, browser, or API. Self-hosted.

Agent-Sandbox is an easy-to-use, enterprise-grade sandbox platform for AI Agents — letting them securely run untrusted LLM-generated code, Browser use, Computer use, and deploy websites, among other tasks.

Markdown-first orchestration for 71 specialists across Codex, Claude, Gemini, and Grok. Chrono coordinates scoped tasks in isolated git worktrees, with tests, cross-family review when triggered, and private Markdown memory. Runs locally in tmux.

A fully customizable and self-hosted sandboxing solution for AI agent code execution and computer use. It features out-of-the-box support for backtracking, a simple REST API and Python SDK, automatic port forwarding, and secure MicroVM isolation. Perfect for safely running, testing, and backtracking multi-step agent workflows.

Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
Playwright for coding agents. Test that your skills, MCP servers, and CLIs actually work when an agent uses them — sandboxed YAML suites, A/B experiments, CI gates.

Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
Lightweight agent orchestration dev tool that lives in your repo
Open-source Python library for AI browser agents, plus Browser Use Cloud: stealth browsers and a hosted agent API.
The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work

Frontend AI coding agent platform with CLI, VS Code extension, desktop app, MCP server, RAG planning, Skills, SDD guardrails, browser automation, and LoRA planner models | 面向前端工程的 AI Agent 平台，支持 CLI、VS Code 插件、桌面端、MCP 服务、RAG、Skills、SDD、浏览器自动化与 LoRA 规划模型

Open-source, self-hosted AI penetration testing framework: maps your attack surface into a graph, autonomously exploits it from a Kali sandbox with human approval gates, and opens PRs that fix what it finds. MCP both ways: plug in any MCP server as a tool, or drive RedAmon from Claude Code or your own agent.
OpenLIT is the open-source agent harness engineering platform: trace, evaluate, guard, and improve everything around the model in your AI agents, on OTEL.

Open-source macOS record-and-replay workflow recorder for computer use agents. Captures mouse, keyboard, and UI events as structured traces so agents can learn, replay, and automate real desktop tasks.

Symbol-level code retrieval for AI agents: fetch the function you need, not the whole file. Runs locally. 94.5% fewer tokens per lookup on average than grep-and-read on our 15-lookup benchmark. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client. Free for non-commercial use; commercial use needs a one-time license.

Open-source AI agent orchestration platform — self-hosted mission control for autonomous multi-agent systems. Visual DAG workflows, 670+ MCP tools, human-in-the-loop approvals. Works with Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, Ollama, Codex.
Comprehensive resources on Generative AI, including a detailed roadmap, projects, use cases, interview preparation, and coding preparation.
Codex computer use, decoupled from the app, for usage inside any harness.
Plan, build and review software with your coding agents. Work side by side in the App or browser, or use your favourite terminal or IDE.
Browser and desktop automation with an MCP server for AI assistants. Record macros or write JavaScript to automate websites, extract data, and control desktop apps with OCR and image recognition.
A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
Open-source AI agent desktop app for Windows & macOS. One-click install Claude Code, MCP tools, and Skills — with sandbox isolation, multi-model support, and Feishu/Slack integration.

Nimbalyst - The open-source visual workspace for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. Run multiple coding agents in parallel, edit their work visually in markdown, mockups, and diagrams, and track tasks. Free, MIT-licensed desktop app for macOS, Windows, Linux, with mobile companion for iOS and Android.

Open-source email infrastructure for AI agents: secure inboxes, REST and MCP APIs, SMTP, human approval workflows, signed webhooks, and Python and TypeScript SDKs. Self-host with Docker and PostgreSQL.
Babysitter enforces obedience on agentic workforces and enables them to manage extremely complex tasks and workflows through deterministic, hallucination-free self-orchestration

Memory layer for AI Agents. Replace complex RAG pipelines with a serverless, single-file memory layer. Give your agents instant retrieval and long-term memory.

Local, LLM-free memory for AI agents. A single offline Rust binary — deterministic and auditable — that learns from use, forgets the irrelevant, and strengthens what matters. No cloud, no API keys.
Open-source memory runtime for AI agents — reproducible, provenance-tagged context bundles instead of query-time retrieval. Apache-2.0, self-hosted on Postgres + pgvector, Python + TypeScript SDKs.

Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

LeanCTX is the Context Gateway for AI Systems. Select task-relevant context, apply supported controls, connect local knowledge and inspect recorded evidence. Open-source Engine: CLI, MCP, hooks and supported proxy paths.
Universal memory layer for AI Agents. It provides scalable, extensible, and interoperable memory storage and retrieval to streamline AI agent state management for next-generation autonomous systems.
